importantCorrection.reason: CameraDeviceSetup createCaptureRequest builder rejected setPhysicalCameraKey with IllegalArgumentException 'Physical camera id: X is not valid!'. The subsequent session support query still ran, but without the requested physical SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE session parameter.
importantCorrection.consequence: Entries labeled PHYSICAL_SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION are duplicate unparameterized support tests after attachment failure and must not be interpreted as successful maximum-pixel-mode session queries.

proven: CameraDeviceSetup is supported for logical camera 0 and camera 1.
Physical-5-bound deferred RAW_SENSOR and RAW10 configurations at 4080x3072, 8160x6144 and 16320x12288 are reported supported without a session pixel-mode parameter.
All predeclared RAW14 configurations tested on physical 5, 2 and 4 are reported unsupported.
The setup builder rejects setPhysicalCameraKey for the disclosed physical IDs in this query context.
notProven: An actual 16320x12288 capture has meaningful 200MP payload population on Android 17.
A physical SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION session parameter can be queried through CameraDeviceSetup.
Honor OEM camera has no privileged RAW14 path.
